A.purpose: UDF JIT integration disabled; CinderX runtime and shared environment unchanged

B.purpose: Existing optimizations enabled; three new lowerings disabled

G.purpose: Existing optimizations plus links and copyright only; language lowering disabled

method.metric: runner metrics.elapsed_s, including Ray initialization and final Lance write
method.baseline: A/B blocks compare UDF integration off with existing optimizations on. B/C,D,E,F,G blocks compare each new lowering combination with existing optimizations on. Shared CinderX runtime configuration stays unchanged.
method.protocol: Independent serial reference/candidate/candidate/reference blocks. A/B: A1 B1 B2 A2; other rounds recorded per block; B/G measured only at 200K with fresh B11 G1 G2 B12.
method.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of two measured runs per arm
method.speedup_formula: mean(reference elapsed_s) / mean(candidate elapsed_s); reference arm comes from baseline_arm
excluded: cross-block total-gain ratios are excluded from paired ABBA gate conclusions

missing_measurements.note: No matching 20K links+copyright ABBA samples were available for this summary; do not extrapolate from 200K.

method.overall_comparison: Reuse the A1/A2 mean from the same mode and size. Divide by each candidate mean from its own measured block. A/B is same-block; A/C,D,E,F,G are explicitly cross-block observations and do not enter the incremental ABBA gate.

correctness.ordering_contract: Unordered output multiset; distributed sink physical order is not a correctness gate.
correctness.stand_in_sink_comparisons: Ten A-F sink-comparison extracts are embedded under comparisons[].correctness.embedded_sink_comparison; B/G equality remains a recorded result.
correctness.real_kenlm_sink_comparisons: Recorded equality results; no fresh full-output comparison was performed.
correctness.output_hash_scope: Final per-arm sink digests, not independent digests for every timing repetition.

limitations: Only two measured samples per arm; no confidence interval or broad statistical stability claim.
M01 is limited to the exact guarded six-profile character-regex helper with lang=en and min_score=0.1; no fastText claim.
Links and copyright apply only to the qualified exact regex signatures and replacements.
All new flags default off and require the literal value 1.
Epoch is supplied explicitly by the environment; results do not validate a missing-epoch deployment.
Real-KenLM 200K combined speedup is positive but below the 1.70x expectation set for stand-in.
Environment and source identities are recorded measurement metadata; the measurement host was not re-audited.
This summary embeds timing samples and selected correctness results, not original runner files, models or full output data. Snapshot hashes alone cannot reconstruct those inputs.
Total A/C,D,E,F,G speedups are cross-block observations. Their source means are measured, but a new direct total-gain ABBA experiment was not performed; drift may affect these ratios.
